newsitem.title: USA: Electroglas says Wozniak named chairman.
newsitem.headline: Electroglas says Wozniak named chairman.

text.p: Electroglas Inc said Monday its Curtis Wozniak has been elected to the additional position of chairman of the company's board.
Wozniak replaces former board chairman Neil Bonke, who will continue to serve as a director.

"Curt has focused the company on aggressive product development, efficient manufacturing and world class customer support," said Bonke. "In addition, he made key infrastructure investments that will effectively take Electroglas into the next century. All this was done during the difficult time of an industry-wide downturn," he said.
Wozniak's has been chief executive for 14 months, the company said.
